scope: Dynamical validity and gradient checks, not representation-learning or energy benchmarks

parameter_scan.protocol: 48 fixed configurations; last 50 of 150 time units classify behavior

paired_pulses.protocol: Two equal unit Gaussian pulses, width .5, first center 10; compare with single-pulse counterfactual; integrate both numerator and denominator over matched 14-unit windows starting at pulse center
paired_pulses.interpretation: Merged responses and relative recovery can be measured; no hard absolute refractory state is implemented

sustained_input.protocol: Step from -0.2 to constant current at t=10; retain transients and late behavior
sustained_input.limitation: A plateau or tonic periodic response is not evidence for indefinite spike-frequency adaptation

coupled_units.initial: Eight phases on the isolated periodic orbit
coupled_units.perturbation_note: Finite 1e-6 perturbation, not a proof of asymptotic contraction

numerical_accuracy.stress_protocol: Constant I=1, initial (.1,3), duration80; avoids missing a narrow pulse on a coarse grid
numerical_accuracy.exponential_note: Frozen forcing exponential Euler: invariant bounds do not mean accurate dynamics at large dt

tangent_counterexample.interpretation: Exact tangent flow at equilibria proves state boundedness does not bound long-horizon sensitivities

certified_stable_variant.tradeoff: This globally contracting regime cannot preserve autonomous tonic oscillations under constant input; representation quality is untested

gradients.method: Exact reverse mode of a specified irregular-step Euler recurrence
gradients.scope: Initial states, input timing and targets fixed independently of differentiated parameters
not_tested: gradient correctness of an adaptive ODE solver
